data.name: Rahiid
data.gender_notes: Rahiid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guides others to the right path. The name Rahiid carries the meaning “The Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rahiid usually hope their child will grow to embody the guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a person who is a spiritual guide or a protector
data.etymology: Rahiid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahiid total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رahid
in_arabic.meaning: الراحد هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الواحد الأحد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الراحد هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى المذكورة في القرآن الكريم، ويعني الواحد الأحد الذي لا شريك له، وهو اسم يدل على توحيد الله وفرادته في الألوهية، وقد ورد ذكره في سورة الحشر: وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الرَّاحِدُ

in_urdu.name: راحید
in_urdu.meaning: واحد اور اکیلا، اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: راحید اللہ تعالیٰ کے اسماء الحسنیٰ میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے واحد اور اکیلا، یہ نام اللہ کی وحدانیت اور اچٹھتا کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر سورہ الحشر میں کیا گیا ہے، وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الرَّاحِدُ، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لئے روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: राहीद
in_hindi.meaning: एकमात्र और अकेला, अल्लाह का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: राहीद अल्लाह के अस्मा-उल-हुसना में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है एकमात्र और अकेला, यह नाम अल्लाह की अद्वैतता और अकेलापन को दर्शाता है, कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख सूरह हश्र में किया गया है, وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الرَّاحِدُ, यह नाम मुसलमानों के लिए आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: رahid
in_pashto.meaning: یوازې او ګنېدلی، د الله نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: رahid د الله د ښو نومونو څخه یو دی، چې معنی یې ده یوازې او ګنېدلی، دا نوم د الله د یووالي او ګنېدلتوب څرګندوي، په قرآن کې ددې نوم يادونه په سوره الحشر کې شوې ده، وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الرَّاحِدُ، دا نوم د مسلمانانو لپاره روحانيت لري

in_english.name: Rahiid
in_english.meaning: One and only, unique, a name of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Rahiid is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning the One and Only, unique and indivisible, it signifies the unity and oneness of God, mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Hashr: وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الرَّاحِدُ, holds spiritual significance for Muslims, reflecting the divine attribute of singularity

Moreover, it represents a strong sense of duty and responsibility to help others find their way and make positive choices in life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rahiid holds great importance as it emphasizes the idea of being a guide or mentor to others, with the ultimate goal of guiding them towards a closer relationship with God. This is an integral part of the Islamic faith, as Muslims believe that guidance from Allah is essential for leading a virtuous and fulfilling life. By carrying the name Rahiid, individuals are encouraged to strive for self-improvement and to provide guidance and support to those around them, ultimately contributing to the betterment of themselves and the broader community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Guide" symbolizes One who guides others to the right path. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rahiid serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the guide.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Rahid was the name of the fifth rightly-guided caliph of Islam, Al-Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan. He ruled from 661 to 680 AD and established the Umayyad Caliphate which lasted for more than two centuries in both Spain and the Middle East.

Rahid is also the name of a famous Islamic scholar, Rahid Al-Din Fahraj-i Kashi, who lived during the Ilkhanate period, around 1310 AD. He is renowned for his work in astronomy, mathematics, and geography, and is considered one of the most prominent figures of the Islamic Golden Age.

On social media platforms like Instagram and Twitter, there are many Rahiid accounts showcasing Islamic art, poetry, and daily inspirations. In the entertainment industry, Rahiid is seen in TV shows and music, as artists seek to represent diverse Muslim experiences and stories, such as the recent Netflix series 'Maharani' featuring a character named Rahiid. In the e-commerce space, online marketplaces catering to Muslim consumers have seen an increase in demand for personalized and inclusive products, including Rahiid-themed merchandise, further solidifying the name's relevance in contemporary culture.
